mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are clear at 53 degrees near Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote by the Common Council. This long-range document focuses on creating strong neighborhoods, supporting our regional employment hub, and ensuring sustainable growth for the future.

We have an exciting lineup starting tomorrow with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, join us for the Puppets in the House festival this Friday at Century School Park, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness on Sunday.

Regarding local safety, on October 3, Verona Police officers located an offender involved in a stolen firearm investigation while conducting a traffic stop for an expired registration, resulting in the recovery of the weapon.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the evening. Please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM, when the shop reopens and we will feature tomorrow's flavor of the day.
